items.title: EPSS Surge: CVE-2024-57726
items.analysis: EPSS exploitation probability for CVE-2024-57726 surged from 0% to 67% (percentile 99%), indicating a significant increase in predicted or observed exploitation activity for this 2024-era vulnerability. It is not (yet) in CISA KEV — this signal typically precedes KEV listing and press coverage. SimpleHelp remote support software v5.5.7 and before has a vulnerability that allows low-privileges technicians to create API keys with excessive permissions. These API keys can be used to escalate privileges to the server admin role.

items.title: EPSS Surge: CVE-2001-0506
items.analysis: EPSS exploitation probability for CVE-2001-0506 surged from 30% to 69% (percentile 99%), indicating a significant increase in predicted or observed exploitation activity for this 2001-era vulnerability. It is not (yet) in CISA KEV — this signal typically precedes KEV listing and press coverage. Buffer overflow in ssinc.dll in IIS 5.0 and 4.0 allows local users to gain system privileges via a Server-Side Includes (SSI) directive for a long filename, which triggers the overflow when the directory name is added, aka the "SSI privilege elevation" vulnerability.
